curated-attraction:crail-1.label: Excellent outdoor dog access
curated-attraction:crail-1.summary: The harbour, foreshore and connected coastal walking are open-air and repeatedly described as dog-friendly. Keep dogs close around working boats, roads, wildlife and any local signs.
curated-attraction:crail-1.sourceName: Crail harbour and beach dog-access cross-check

curated-attraction:crail-2.label: Pet-dog admission not confirmed
curated-attraction:crail-2.summary: Pet-dog admission could not be confirmed. The museum’s own current visitor page does not publish a policy, while a museum directory lists assistance dogs but not ordinary pet dogs indoors; contact the museum before relying on admission.
curated-attraction:crail-2.sourceName: Crail Museum official page and museum directory cross-check

curated-attraction:crail-3.label: Dogs reported in certain areas
curated-attraction:crail-3.summary: A current third-party travel guide reports dogs welcome in certain pottery and garden areas, but the operator does not publish a formal policy. The courtyard is the safest assumption; telephone before relying on indoor access.
curated-attraction:crail-3.sourceName: Crail Pottery operator and third-party dog-access cross-check

osm-community:node-7657404154.label: Dogs welcomed inside and outside
osm-community:node-7657404154.summary: Several independent visitor reports from 2023-2026 describe dogs being welcomed at indoor tables and in the sea-view courtyard. The operator page confirms indoor and courtyard service but does not publish a formal dog policy.
osm-community:node-7657404154.sourceName: Harbour Gallery operator and multiple visitor reports

curated-attraction:crail-roome-bay.label: Dogs welcome all year
curated-attraction:crail-roome-bay.summary: Two dog-specific Crail guides identify Roome Bay as a year-round dog-friendly beach. Keep dogs controlled around children, wildlife, rock pools and any temporary local signs.

hes-listed-building:crail-lb23244.label: Kirkyard works; church unconfirmed
hes-listed-building:crail-lb23244.summary: The open-air kirkyard can be visited with a controlled dog, but no reliable current policy for ordinary pet dogs inside the church could be confirmed; assistance dogs are unaffected.

hes-listed-building:crail-lb23402.label: Excellent open-air dog stop
hes-listed-building:crail-lb23402.summary: Castle Walk is an open-air link within Crail’s dog-friendly coastal walking network. Keep dogs close on steps, near roads and around other visitors.
hes-listed-building:crail-lb23402.sourceName: Castle Walk and dog-friendly Crail cross-check

hes-listed-building:crail-lb23445.label: Grounds good; interior unconfirmed
hes-listed-building:crail-lb23445.summary: The doocot stands in dog-walkable Roome Bay greenspace, but no reliable policy for pet dogs inside the small restored structure could be confirmed.
hes-listed-building:crail-lb23445.sourceName: Fife Council Roome Bay and doocot visitor-information review

hes-listed-building:crail-lb23287.label: Marketgate good; hall unconfirmed
hes-listed-building:crail-lb23287.summary: The exterior and Marketgate form an easy open-air stop with a dog. No reliable current pet-dog policy for event-dependent Town Hall interiors could be confirmed.

curated-food:crail-shoregate.label: Dogs welcome in the bar
curated-food:crail-shoregate.summary: Dogs are explicitly welcome in the historic bar, where lunch is available, but not in the dining room; dinner is dining-room only.

osm-community:node-7657404154.label: Dogs welcomed inside and outside
osm-community:node-7657404154.summary: Multiple recent visitor reports specifically describe dogs being welcomed at indoor tables and in the sea-view outdoor area; the operator site itself does not publish a formal policy.
osm-community:node-7657404154.sourceName: Recent Crail Harbour Gallery visitor reports

curated-food:crail-golf-hotel.label: Dogs welcome in bar and garden
curated-food:crail-golf-hotel.summary: A current local dog-friendly guide specifically confirms dogs in the public bar and beer garden; the main restaurant policy remains unconfirmed.

osm-community:node-5902078913.label: Designated dog-friendly dining area
osm-community:node-5902078913.summary: Recent visitor evidence identifies a dog-friendly restaurant area and reports water and treats; request that area when booking because the operator does not publish a site-wide policy.
osm-community:node-5902078913.sourceName: Recent Balcomie Links Hotel visitor reports

osm-community:way-225526906.label: Takeaway is the dependable dog option
osm-community:way-225526906.summary: The current search did not find a published indoor dog policy. The takeaway service works with a dog, but check directly before relying on cafe seating.
